source: Primer (GitHub's own design system) primitives, dark theme — primer/primitives, src/tokens/base/color/dark/dark.json5 and src/tokens/functional/color/{bgColor,fgColor,borderColor}.json5 (github.com/primer/primitives). The brand mark colour (#181717) is GitHub's own published value from github.com/logos, via the simple-icons dataset (github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons, data/simple-icons.json — CC0, sourced by that project directly from each brand's own guidelines). Not sampled from a screenshot.
watermarkNote: GitHub's own Octocat mark, reused faint as the corner watermark (no separate glyph asset the way PyPI has package cubes).

gradientLight.role: gradient light stop — Primer's dark-theme 'muted background' step

base.role: panel background — bgColor.default, GitHub's canonical dark canvas colour

gradientDark.role: gradient dark stop — Primer's true near-black

accent.role: left spine accent — Primer's own 'accent' link/interactive blue

positive.role: optional — star/visibility dot; unused in the current layout, kept for reuse

type.source: GitHub's UI does not ship a distinctive brand webfont — Primer's typography tokens specify the system font stack (-apple-system, "Segoe UI", ... for text; ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, ... for code), so this card reuses the same embedded Source Sans 3 / Source Code Pro as the PyPI card for visual consistency across platforms rather than mimicking a system stack that would render differently per viewer.

logoUsageNote: The Octocat mark is a GitHub trademark — use it to refer to GitHub itself, not to brand something else.
